# A target lane's track: a low earth bed 19 m long, 1.0 m wide, 0.06 m proud of the grass, that
# the targets' sled runners slide on. Along X. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bed --base-color 0.6078 0.6118 0.5098 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Bed --size 1 --location 0 0 0.03
scale 19 1.0 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Bed
active Bed
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export track.glb
